rationale: The agent successfully authenticated Sofia Li by matching her name with her zip code. The agent then completed the exchange of the bicycle for a larger frame size and successfully exchanged the camera for a lower resolution model. Although the agent informed Sofia that only one exchange could be made for her jigsaw puzzle, they processed the requests accurately and confirmed the user's action to cancel the skateboard order, which the user stated they would do themselves. The actions were consistent with the retail support policy.
